entry.title: UniFi Access Point for U6-LR, U6-Lite & more 6.7.57
entry.summary:
Overview This release is only for these models:
U6-LR/U6-Lite UAP-nanoHD/FlexHD/BeaconHD/IW-HD
Improvements
Added Test & Confirm mode to automatically revert configuration changes if the device becomes unreachable or the test period expires without confirmation.
Bugfixes
Fixed clients failing to receive an IP address after changing an Enterprise WiFi network to Open. Fixed certain 2.4 GHz IoT devices repeatedly reconnecting while appearing connected. Fixed an issue where U6-LR could report unusually high channel utilization.
Additional information If you encounter any issues with this release, please provide us with some details on your setup and include the below information:
AP model(s) Previous AP release version UniFi Network application version
